mil7.6.6:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, satapattassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahe tabban-ti.-
mil7.6.6:1.2: Yathā mahārāja satapatto ravitvā paresaṃ khemaṃ vā bhayaṃ vā ācikkhati,
mil7.6.6:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena paresaṃ dhammaṃ desayamānena vinipātaṃ bhayato dassayitabbaṃ, nibbānaṃ khemato dassayitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.6:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja satapattassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
